jobDescription.name: About &Open
jobDescription.value:
We’re the global gifting platform for companies that care.

Our platform sends gifts globally at scale, while our team guides the process with taste, thought and attention to detail.

As a B Corp-certified company, we’re all about less waste, more impact. At the end of the day, it’s not how much you send, it’s how you make people feel that matters.

Our customers include OpenAI, Hubspot, Revolut and Fin.

jobDescription.name: About the team
jobDescription.value: &Open’s Account Management team is growing. We work closely with clients every step of the way. From platform onboarding, expansion & renewals (and all the little details in between), we ensure that desired goals are achieved and clients are happy. What we love most: creating strong relationships that lead to lasting partnerships. This is only made possible through constant collaboration and communication across all &Open teams.

jobDescription.name: About the role
jobDescription.value: We’re seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Manager in Dublin, Ireland to represent &Open to our clients, including both European and American based clients. &Open is a B2B platform that helps global brands build connections with their communities, and we’re looking for a commercial thinker and a passionate, helpful and charismatic communicator to fuel our revenue growth and success. This role requires strong collaboration skills in constructive client engagement and a passion for working with internal partners to achieve designated objectives. The ideal candidate must excel at confident communication, have excellent sales experience and be a star at developing and maintaining client relationships. The role may also require some flexible working hours to support clients in different timezones.

jobDescription.name: What you'll do?
jobDescription.value:
Manage client accounts

  • Be the primary POC. Act as the main point of contact for enterprise clients. Continuously seek opportunities to provide additional value to ongoing client projects and consequently growth for &Open. Demonstrate a deep understanding of client objectives, challenges and opportunities.

  • Manage a sales quota working with some of the biggest logos globally 

  • Project manage. Specifically when it comes to corporate gifting programs and campaigns for enterprise clients, including initial onboarding with internal teams. 

  • Build trust. Create relationships to become a trusted advisor and reliable partner for our clients. Manage their renewals.

  • Drive Growth. Create and manage upsell opportunities through the customer lifecycle 


Contribute to growth

  • Specialise. Develop a deep understanding of &Open’s products and be able to communicate our unique value proposition to new and potential clients.

  • Be an industry expert. Know the ins and outs of the corporate gifting marketplace, including key user groups, use cases, competitors and trends.

  • React quickly. Provide feedback to your partners on anything you’re hearing in the space (or from customers), developing an informed point of view on what it will take to succeed in the market.

  • Problem solve. Have the foresight to proactively solve problems, even if they are outside of your expertise or current responsibilities.

jobDescription.name: What you'll need
jobDescription.value:
• 3+ years of relationship management & enterprise sales experience 

  • Experience in technology, design or marketing industries

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent in a related field

  • Excellent communication skills; we’re looking for detailed writers and confident speakers

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects at once

  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively, driving cross-functional solutions alongside others

  • Flexibility to work EST time zone, to support our American-based customers.

  • A strategic mindset; you must have the ability to think beyond immediate needs, determining what will drive long-term success for both your clients and &Open

  • A self-starter attitude that’s comfortable working autonomously

jobDescription.name: Benefits
jobDescription.value:
• Competitive Salary

  • Hybrid Working Model

  • Company Pension

  • Healthcare cover

  • 25 days Annual Leave + 2 Company Days 

  • Maternity and Paternity Paid Leave

  • Exciting experience in a fast-paced start-up environment

  • Employee Stock Options Plan

jobDescription.name: Location
jobDescription.value: Head Office Dublin, Ireland (Harold's Cross). Hybrid working model.

jobDescription.value:
We’re the global gifting platform for companies that care.


Our platform sends gifts globally at scale, while our team guides the process with taste, thought and attention to detail.

Come and grow with us.

jobDescription.name: About the team
jobDescription.value:
You’ll report to the Head of Sales and work closely with the account executive and the marketing teams. 
&Open’s Sales team is a dynamic group of individuals who play a crucial role in company growth. Expanding quickly, the team works to create the best possible outcomes for customers with ease and proficiency — providing simple solutions to complex problems. They care about every detail, and are the creative problem solvers who power long-lasting client relationships. If you thrive in B2B environments and often categorise yourself as “being up for the challenge” when it comes to both strategy and thinking on your feet, you’ll feel right at home on our wonderful Sales team.

jobDescription.name: About the role
jobDescription.value: We’re seeking a Global Business Development Representative to join our growing Sales team. Primary responsibilities will include becoming an expert on our target market(s) and building connections to boost sales & engagement. This candidate will stand out if they bring initiative, passion and a few years of relevant experience to the table, setting the pace and leading by example for team members to come.

jobDescription.name: What you'll do?
jobDescription.value:
• Hunter mentality: Focus on outbounding and creating pipeline through cold calling and emailing.

  • Manage inbound and outbound leads. Mainly in relation to day-to-day sales processes. Develop qualified leads for an overall deeper sales engagement.

  • Create a pipeline. Engage with prospective accounts across a range of channels from inbound, outbound, social and referrals.

  • Oversee our sales CRM. This requires diligence, attention to detail and care.

  • Learn the target market. Understand what customers desire and how we can help solve their challenges. Always synthesise your learnings and be prepared to share them with the broader team, keeping us in front of our competitors.

  • Be an advocate. We’ve developed an innovative approach to corporate gifting and you’ll be the first person to tell our prospects about it. Remain passionate and informed whilst taking the time to listen and understand prospects’ needs.

  • Self-start. AKA bring your own ideas into the fold. Work collaboratively and creatively with our team to help develop target lists and identify new business channels.

jobDescription.name: What you'll need
jobDescription.value:
• 1-2 years of relevant work experience in sales or business development, lead generation and/or marketing

  • 1+ years of experience in a tech, media or creative work environment

  • Experience using Google Suite and Salesforce

  • B2B SaaS enterprise sales experience is a plus

  • Strong ability to communicate with clarity, energetic confidence and a conversational tone that fosters human connection

  • History of collaboration, working with internal and external partners to achieve team goals

  • Quick learning skills coupled with innovative ideas

  • Energy, enthusiasm and passion for the role and &Open’s offerings

  • Rigorous attention to detail — both with internal and external deliverables

  • Excellent time management and prioritisation skills

  • A positive and resilient can-do attitude, as this is a business development role

  • Ability to continuously engage and empathise with prospective accounts while simultaneously collaborating with the broader &Open team

jobDescription.value:

  • Company Pension

  • Healthcare cover

  • 25 days Annual Leave + 2 Company Days 

  • Maternity and Paternity Paid Leave

  • Exciting experience in a fast-paced start-up environment

Our customers include OpenAI, HubSpot, Revolut and Fin.

Come and grow with us.

jobDescription.name: About the team
jobDescription.value:
You’ll report to the VP of Growth and Marketing.

You’ll work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success and Design to turn what we ship into reasons for customers to use more of the platform.

jobDescription.name: About the role
jobDescription.value:
As our Product Marketing Lead, you’ll own the story of &Open’s platform — translating product capabilities into the content and assets that drive adoption across the teams who use it every day: People & HR, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Events.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You’ll set the product marketing strategy and produce the work yourself, acting as the connective tissue between Product, Sales and Customer Success so every feature launch and customer touchpoint gives users a clear reason to go deeper with &Open.

jobDescription.name: What you'll do?
jobDescription.value:
• Own product marketing strategy for the &Open platform, with a focus on driving feature adoption and expansion among existing customers.

  • Plan and produce adoption-focused content and assets — in-app messaging, onboarding flows, product one-pagers, email nurture sequences, video walkthroughs, help centre content and release notes — that help customers discover and use more of the platform.

  • Partner closely with Product on the roadmap, translating new features into clear positioning, messaging and go-to-market plans.

  • Build and manage launch plans for new features and platform updates, coordinating with Sales, Customer Success and Marketing to land them with existing customers.

  • Develop sales and CS enablement materials — battlecards, demo scripts, case studies — that help teams sell and expand usage of the platform.

  • Use product usage data and customer feedback to identify adoption gaps and prioritise content and asset production accordingly.

  • Partner with Design and Content to make sure everything you produce reflects &Open’s brand and tone.

  • Track and report on adoption metrics tied to your campaigns and content, iterating based on what drives engagement.

jobDescription.name: What you'll need
jobDescription.value:
• 5+ years of experience in product marketing, ideally at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of driving product adoption through content and campaigns.

  • Proven experience producing marketing assets end-to-end — writing, briefing designers and shipping content independently.

  • Strong writing skills and the ability to translate technical product features into customer-facing value.

  • Experience partnering with Product, Sales and Customer Success teams to plan and execute launches.

  • Comfortable using product usage and analytics data to inform content strategy.

  • You’re based in Ireland and able to work hybrid from our Dublin office.

  • A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced start-up environment and enjoys owning projects end-to-end.


Our interview process is designed to be fast. Most candidates get through the entire process in less than two weeks, and we’ll give you a clear decision quickly. We don’t ask you to create any new or original work while interviewing with us.

jobDescription.value:

As a B Corp-certified company, we're all about less waste, more impact. At the end of the day, it's not how much you send, it's how you make people feel that matters.

Our customers include OpenAI, Hubspot, Revolut and Fin.
Come and grow with us.

jobDescription.name: About the team
jobDescription.value:
Fintan is our CTO. He's been hands on with our integrations and API from the start and will be your escalation point on anything technical that runs deeper than a workaround. Juan is our Head of Engineering. He's built a team of Product Engineers who own the integrations and API you'll be putting in front of customers. Ross, our Engineering Specialist, does a lot of this work today and will be the person you learn the current set-ups from. You'll also work closely with our Head of Product.

On the commercial side you'll work with Amber, our VP of Growth and Marketing, and with our account managers and sales team. They bring the customers; you make the technical side of the promise hold. You'll have exposure to and often collaborate with our senior leadership team, right up to the CEO.

jobDescription.name: About the role
jobDescription.value:
Think about the moment a new customer signs with &Open. They've bought into the idea: gifts that land at the right time, for the right person, sent from the tools their team already works in. Now someone has to make that real. Their HubSpot needs to talk to our platform. The automation they were promised in the sales call needs to actually fire. The account needs to be set up so the first gift goes out without a hitch.

Today that work is spread across a lot of people: our Head of Product, our CTO, account managers, engineers. Everyone does a piece of it and nobody owns it end to end. You will.

You'll be our first Solutions Engineer. You'll sit between our customers and our product, working out how &Open fits into the systems they already run, designing the solution, and seeing it through until the integration is live and being used. Then you'll bring what you learned back to the product team so the next customer needs less of your help.

We're a startup, so the job changes shape week to week. One day you're on a call with a prospect walking through how our API works, the next you're deep in a HubSpot workflow with a customer's ops team, the next you're writing the playbook so it goes faster the time after that.

jobDescription.name: What you'll do?
jobDescription.value:
You'll work across the whole customer journey, from the first technical conversation in a sales cycle to a live integration with automations running. That means our platform, our integrations with the tools our customers already use, our API, and the customer's own systems.
  • Run technical demos. Cross-system flows, integrations, the API. Product demos too when nobody else can, but the technical ones are yours.
  • Gather requirements from customers. Understand what they're trying to do, what systems they run, and what "working" looks like for them.
  • Design solutions. Work out how our product layers into the customer's existing systems to solve their need. When the product doesn't do it out of the box, design the workaround, whether that's configuration on our side, setup in their tools, or something like Zapier in between.
  • Get customers live. Set up our integrations and product for them, and set up the other pieces of the solution too, like the HubSpot workflows that trigger a gift.
  • Drive adoption. An integration that's connected but not used doesn't count. You own getting automations live and keeping them live.
  • Troubleshoot and debug. When an integration, automation or bespoke solution breaks for a customer you've worked with, you're the first call.
  • Write it down. Find the gaps in our documentation and playbooks, fill the important ones yourself, delegate the rest, and review what others write.
  • Feed the product team. You'll see more customer set-ups than anyone else here. Bring the patterns back to Product and Engineering so workarounds become features and gaps get closed.
  • Ship some code. Not much, but some. Small, contained changes where you know exactly what's needed and it's faster to do it than to explain it.
  • Use AI as a matter of course. We already automate reporting, research synthesis and prototyping with it, and integration work suits it well. We want you to push that further.
When you join, you'll spend time with the people who do pieces of this work today: Account Management, Sales, Product and Engineering. You'll shadow demos and onboarding calls before you run them, and you'll meet customers early.

jobDescription.name: What you'll need
jobDescription.value:
• 3-6 years in a solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation or technical account management role at a B2B software company, ideally somewhere small enough that you did the whole job yourself without a delivery team behind you.
  • Integrations you've delivered end to end that you can talk through in detail: what the customer needed, how you designed it, what went wrong, and whether it stuck.
  • Comfort with APIs, webhooks and the plumbing between systems. You can read API docs, make requests, inspect a payload and work out why something didn't fire.
  • Hands-on experience with a CRM or marketing platform like HubSpot, and with automation tools like Zapier or Make.
  • Some ability to code. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can read code, write a script, and land a small change with an engineer's review.
  • You're good in front of customers. You can run a demo, hold a requirements conversation with an ops or RevOps team, and explain a technical constraint without hiding behind it.
  • You write well. Playbooks and documentation are a core part of the job, not an afterthought.
  • You use AI every day and you can show us how. We'd like to see the prompts, workflows, agents or tools you've built to make your own work faster.
  • You're happy being hands on. We do good work and we hold a high bar, but we get scrappy when the situation calls for it, and you'll switch between the two often.
  • You're at home with ambiguity, and with owning something nobody has owned before.
  • You're based in Dublin or, if working remotely, within a couple of hours of the GMT timezone. If you're remote, you're ok with some very occasional travel to collaborate with the team in person or attend important company events.
The interview process
Our process is designed to be fast. Most candidates get through the entire process in less than two weeks, and we'll give you a clear decision quickly.
All applications are reviewed by the hiring manager for the role. We don't use AI agents for automated decision-making.
